image.name: opndrm-prime/buzz-container
image.purpose: Immutable local Apple Container image for future one-bot, one-task Buzz coding VMs.
image.tag_policy: The project build script refuses to overwrite an existing tag. Change this manifest and review the image definition before using a new tag.

tools.name: HERDR
tools.notes: Official Linux aarch64 release binary. Terminal use is possible only after a future approved task lifecycle; no graphical desktop is provided.

tools.name: JCode
tools.notes: Official Linux aarch64 release archive. Its documented anonymous telemetry is disabled in the image. No model, provider, account, or task configuration is included.

tools.name: WezTerm
tools.reason: The established Captain HERDR/WezTerm daily driver and its saved layout remain host-local and untouched. This separate headless task image does not install, configure, or recreate a WezTerm GUI or session layout.

tools.name: Prime Agent
tools.notes: Uses the official installer’s published release tarball and checksum origin with an exact Node.js Linux arm64 runtime. npm lifecycle scripts are disabled, so Prime Agent does not bootstrap tools/kernel, launch a daemon, create a session, or configure a model/provider. Its CLI is deliberately not executed by the image verifier.

tools.name: No Mistakes
tools.reason: It is not installed because the requested image must keep the gate inactive. No Mistakes must not be added until its official Linux installation path can be verified to avoid daemon/pipeline startup and credentials.
